message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.** Atlanta’s noise‑related violations are handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department (APD)** and the **City Hall Code Enforcement Office**. Below is a quick guide on how to report a noise issue, what the city’s noise ordinance covers, and the main contact points. --- ## 1. How to File a Noise Complaint | Method | What to Do | Contact | |--------|------------|---------| | **Online (311)** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal:
• Select “Noise” or “Code Enforcement” from the list of services.
• Fill out the form with details (location, time, description, photos if possible).
• Submit. | 311 (free, 24/7) | | **Phone** | • Call the APD’s non‑emergency line: **404‑656‑4000**
• Tell the dispatcher you’re filing a noise complaint.
• Provide the same details as above. | 404‑656‑4000 | | **Email** | • Send an email to **noisecomplaint@atlantaga.gov** with the same information. | noisecomplaint@atlantaga.gov | | **In‑person** | • Visit the City Hall at 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303.
• Go to the “City Hall” lobby and ask for the “Code Enforcement” desk. | City Hall, 55 MLK Jr. Dr. | > **Tip:** If the noise is an emergency (e.g., a fire alarm, a dangerous situation), call **911** immediately. --- ## 2. What the City’s Noise Ordinance Covers - **General Rule**: Noise that is “unreasonable” or “excessive” during certain hours is prohibited. - **Typical Hours**: - **Weekdays**: 10 p.m. – 7 a.m. - **Weekends & Holidays**: 11 p.m. – 7 a.m. - **Specific Prohibitions** (examples): - Loud music or amplified sound from a residence or business. - Construction noise that exceeds the permitted hours. - Use of loud machinery or equipment in a residential area during prohibited times. - **Penalties**: Violations can result in fines, citations, or other enforcement actions. > *For the full text of the noise ordinance, see the City of Atlanta’s Municipal Code, Title 12 – Public Health and Safety, Chapter 1 – General Provisions, Section 12‑1‑2.* --- ## 3. Quick Reference Links | Resource | Link | |----------|------| | City of Atlanta 311 Portal | | | City of Atlanta Municipal Code (Noise Ordinance) | | | Atlanta Police Department Contact Page | | | City Hall Address | 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 | --- ### Bottom Line - **Yes**, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. - Use the 311 portal, call 404‑656‑4000, email noisecomplaint@atlantaga.gov, or visit City Hall. - The city’s noise ordinance defines what constitutes excessive noise and sets enforcement hours. If you have any more questions—whether it’s about the specific wording of the ordinance, how to document the noise, or what to expect after filing—feel free to ask!
